_doc: Signature foes (World.PlaceFoes): after the wilds are made, one site in fitting country is given over to each of these masters. Their lineages in history.json (by monster) give them their leaders, titles and strikes when they fester into menaces. Rings are 0 (near) to 4 (far).
raiseText: Graves dug for the {n} raiders who fell at {town} are found open. The spirit-caller of {site} has called them home, and they will walk with its dead.

texts.poach: {ranger} of {camp} rides into {site} ahead of the town's heroes and comes out with the job done and the {gold} gold bounty in her saddlebag.
texts.hired: {ranger} counts the gold twice, then hangs her black cloak in the tavern. She rides for the town now, and the Black Bough's camp is empty.
texts.tolerated: The council lets it be known that {ranger} may hunt the town's bounties, so long as half the reward finds its way home.
texts.hunted: The council puts {ranger}'s camp at {camp} on the bounty map. Whoever brings her in can keep her bow.

foes.text: an ancient dragon on a mountain of coin, awake before they landed and amused that they came
the packlord gnawing on something that used to be a cart-horse
a three-headed hound straining at its chain while the cult's keepers feed it coals
the horned spirit-caller crouched over a bowl of smoke, the dead standing round it in a ring
the dark ranger, already nocking an arrow, who knew they were coming before they did
a fire giant at a forge the size of a house, hammering out a sword for a war that has not started yet
a cloud giant lord on a throne of mist, who has been expecting them and finds them small
a storm giant standing in the surf with lightning in its fist
